Sample.evidence_source: [page/4/Text/9] In this study a sample of 13 male participants (ranging from 21 to 25 years) was recruited.

Country.evidence_source: [page/5/Text/7] The interviews with these young men were analysed to explore the experiences of a specific group of people (South African male university students who had attempted suicide).

Population.evidence_source: [page/5/Text/7] Of the 13 participants that were recruited, four participants disclosed that they had previously attempted suicide. The interviews of these four young men are the focus of this article. The interviews with these young men were analysed to explore the experiences of a specific group of people (South African male university students who had attempted suicide).

Type.evidence_source: [page/4/Text/9] The study used qualitative data, which was collected as part of the research component of a Master's degree in Psychology (Meissner 2013).
